name: Porta-Porta Italian Restaurant - Picardy Garden
description:
Savor Southern Italian cuisine from our large variety of antipasti, pasta, and main courses.

Full of Southern Italian flavor of garlic, tomato, and olive oil dishes with a pizzicare (hinch)of spice. Simple yet tasty! Too spoilt for choice?

Try our “Fai te” dinner set, which means “you do it”, leaving everything to our chefs while you sit down and enjoy everyone’s favorites that our chefs cook for you.

A homely restaurant, opening our doors to our home-cooked food with an ambiance that would make you feel like you are in someone’s home in southern Italy.

A dining experience which a lot of customers have cherished and enjoyed for over 25 years.
